title: Grid Detective — Row & Column Sum Puzzle Explorer
description: Interactive step-based grid puzzle explorer for Grade 7 Mathematics — Chapter 6: Number Play. Redesigned with Singularity Design System: Poppins font, #4A4DC9 primary purple, #FF7212 orange accent, pill-shaped buttons with Enabled/Disabled/Hover/Pressed states, Contained/Outlined/Text/Highlight button variants. Hints are text-based reasoning clues — they never reveal the answer directly in the grid.
subject: Mathematics
topic: Explorations in Grids — Row and Column Sums

enableHints.description: Show hint button in practice mode. Hints are text-based reasoning clues that guide the student's thinking without revealing the answer or its position.

icons.note: Grid3X3 was removed — does not exist in lucide-react. Target is used for the header icon.

learnMode.description: 6-step guided walkthrough solving a 3x3 grid puzzle
steps: Read the clues — row and column sum targets
Cross-check with column sums to narrow down
Complete Row 3 and verify all sums

practiceMode.description: Independent puzzle solving with randomly generated grids
interactions: Click number chip to select, click cell to place
Drag-and-drop number chips to grid cells
Click filled cell to remove its number
Green glow for correct placements, red glow for wrong
Confetti animation on successful puzzle completion

hintSystem.description: Hints appear as a dismissible text banner below the number chips. They guide reasoning without revealing answers or highlighting cells.
strategies: Row nearly complete (2 of 3 filled) — tells partial sum and target, asks student to find the difference
Column nearly complete (2 of 3 filled) — same logic for columns
Empty row — suggests starting with most constrained row, lists available numbers
Wrong placement detected — points out row/column sum mismatch, suggests removal
General fallback — lists remaining numbers, suggests focusing on nearly-complete row/column
hintSystem.manualDismiss: X button on the hint banner

instructions_for_student: Follow along as the grid is solved step by step using logical reasoning. Watch how listing possible triplets and cross-checking with column sums narrows down 3,62,880 possibilities to just one answer. Then try solving a new grid on your own! If you get stuck, tap Hint for a reasoning clue — it won't give you the answer, but it will point you in the right direction.

teaching_notes.step1: Emphasize the scale of the problem (3,62,880 arrangements).
teaching_notes.step2: Guide student to read ALL constraints before filling cells.
teaching_notes.step3: Show how to list triplets systematically.
teaching_notes.step4: Demonstrate cross-checking — the key reasoning step.
teaching_notes.step5: Let student predict Row 2 before revealing.
teaching_notes.step6: Switch to practice mode for independent solving.
teaching_notes.hints: Hints are deliberately text-based — they teach reasoning strategies (partial sums, elimination, cross-checking) rather than giving away answers. This builds transferable problem-solving skills.

changelog.2.1.0: Text-based hint system replacing grid-highlight hints. Fixed Grid3X3 icon (not in lucide-react) replaced with Target. Removed unused hintCell/showHint state. Added dismissible hint banner with 5 smart strategies.
changelog.2.0.0: Redesigned with Singularity Design System. Poppins font, purple/orange palette, DSButton component with 4 variants and 4 states.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial version with Lilita One + Nunito fonts, sky blue palette, grid-highlight hints.
